data.name: Jaber
data.gender_notes: Jaber is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'j-b-r' which means 'to give' or 'to bestow'. The name Jaber signifies a person who is generous, giving, and magnanimous. The name Jaber carries the meaning “The Generous” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Jaber usually hope their child will grow to embody the generous and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes generosity and selflessness, encouraging the recipient to pay it forward and continue the cycle of kindness and support.
data.etymology: Jaber belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “The Generous.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jaber total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: جابر
in_arabic.meaning: جابر تعني الشخص الذي يجبر أو يعطي القوة
in_arabic.long_meaning: جابر هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي و معناه الشخص الذي يجبر أو يعطي القوة، وقد ورد ذكره في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع، منها قوله تعالى: 'وَيَجْبُرُ عَظْمِيَ وَيَمُدُّ عَضُدي'، ويعتبر هذا الاسم من الأسماء ذات الأهمية الكبيرة في التراث الإسلامي، حيث يوحي بالشجاعة و القوة.

in_urdu.name: جابر
in_urdu.meaning: جابر کا مطلب ہے وہ شخص جو دوسروں کو طاقت دیتا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: جابر ایک عربی मूल کا مذکر نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے وہ شخص جو دوسروں کو طاقت دیتا ہے یا ان کی مدد کرتا ہے۔ یہ نام قرآن کریم میں بھی ذکر کیا گیا ہے، جیسے کہ 'وَيَجْبُرُ عَظْمِيَ وَيَمُدُّ عَضُدي'، یہ نام اسلامی تقليد میں اہم سمجھا جاتا ہے کیونکہ یہ ہمت اور مضبوطی کی علامت ہے۔

in_hindi.name: जाबेर
in_hindi.meaning: जाबेर का अर्थ है जो व्यक्ति शक्ति प्रदान करता है
in_hindi.long_meaning: जाबेर एक अरबी मूल का पुल्लिंग नाम है जिसका अर्थ है जो व्यक्ति शक्ति प्रदान करता है या दूसरों की मदद करता है। यह नाम कुरआन में भी उल्लेखित है, जैसे कि 'وَيَجْبُرُ عَظْمِيَ وَيَمُدُّ عَضُدي'। यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में महत्वपूर्ण माना जाता है क्योंकि यह साहस और मजबूती का प्रतीक है।

in_pashto.name: جابر
in_pashto.meaning: جابر د معنا دا دی چې کوم سړی بل چاته ځواک ورکوي
in_pashto.long_meaning: جابر د عربي اصل يو مذکر نوم دی چې د معنا يې دا دی چې کوم سړی بل چاته ځواک ورکوي يا د هغه سره مرسته کوي. دا نوم په قرآن کريم کې هم ذکر شوی، لکه 'وَيَجْبُرُ عَظْمِيَ وَيَمُدُّ عَضُدي'، دا نوم په اسلامي دود کې مهم ګڼل کیږي ځکه چې د زړورتیا او پیاوړتیا نښه ده.

in_english.name: Jaber
in_english.meaning: Jaber means the one who gives strength or power
in_english.long_meaning: Jaber is a masculine given name of Arabic origin, meaning 'the one who gives strength or power'. It is derived from the Arabic root 'ج-ب-ر' which conveys the idea of strength and power. The name Jaber is mentioned in the Quran, for example, 'وَيَجْبُرُ عَظْمِيَ وَيَمُدُّ عَضُدي', signifying its importance in Islamic tradition. It symbolizes courage, resilience, and spiritual strength, making it a significant and popular name among Muslim communities worldwide.

data.cultural_impact: The name Jaber holds a rich cultural significance in the Muslim world. It represents a noble character trait that is highly valued in Islamic society - that of being generous and kind to others. The name Jaber is often associated with compassion, hospitality, and charitable giving. It is also believed that those named Jaber possess the ability to bestow blessings upon others, making them respected and admired figures in their communities.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Jaber embodies the Islamic principle of giving and generosity, as mentioned in the Quran. The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) is reported to have said, "Giving a gift does away with debts." (Bukhari and Muslim). Thus, the name Jaber serves as a constant reminder to those who bear it to strive towards embodying the virtues of kindness, generosity, and selflessness, not only to their loved ones, but also to the larger society. By living up to the meaning of their name, Jabers are fulfilling a divine command to be good to others and to bestow God's blessings upon the world around them.
